units.source_text: 这趟列车在大竹七段所在的平塚不靠站，所以他们相约在小田原站会面。

en.t: This train did not stop at Hiratsuka, where Otake 7-dan was staying, so they arranged to meet at Odawara Station.

units.source_text: 不多久，七段头戴帽檐低垂的巴拿马草帽、身穿藏青色夏服出现了。

en.t: Before long, the 7-dan appeared, wearing a Panama hat with its brim pulled low and a dark blue summer suit.

units.source_text: 他把闲居山中所穿的衣裳也都带到红叶馆来。

en.t: He had also brought to the Momijikan all the clothes he wore while living quietly in the mountains.
There was a large leather suitcase.

units.source_text: 他们一见面，首先就谈起灾情来。

en.t: As soon as they met, the first thing they talked about was the disaster.
